[EFFECT] Year acts as a simple step change: 2011 hours (blue) sit at a moderately negative contribution and 2012 hours (red) sit at a moderately positive one, reflecting overall system growth from one year to the next.
[IMPORTANCE] This is the third most important feature, with a clearly visible but narrower spread than hour and temperature.
[RECOMMENDATION] Focus operational planning — bike availability and staffing — primarily on the hour of day and temperature, as these two features drive the vast majority of demand variation; ensure full availability during warm-weather daytime hours and scale back overnight and in cold conditions.
